title: Sunglasses Try-On with Physics Debug Overlay
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a sunglasses virtual try-on experience with a physics debug overlay. Load the 'Lantern.glb' model using GLTFLoader as a decorative prop in the scene.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a Three.js scene with a soft gradient background (top: #1a1a2e, bottom: #16213e).
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.6, 3) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and two directional lights: key light at (3, 4, 2) intensity 0.8, fill light at (-2, 1, -1) intensity 0.3.
- Create a mannequin head using basic geometries: a sphere (radius 0.35) for the head, a cylinder (radius 0.05, height 0.4) for the neck, positioned at (0, 1.5, 0) and (0, 1.1, 0) respectively. Use MeshStandardMaterial with skin tone color #e8beac.
- Create sunglasses from basic geometries: two torus shapes (radius 0.08, tube 0.015) for lens frames, two flat circle meshes (radius 0.07) with dark tinted material (opacity 0.7) for lenses, a thin box for the bridge connecting them, and two thin cylinders for temple arms. Group all into a sunglasses group.
- Load 'Lantern.glb' using GLTFLoader and place it at position (-1.5, 0, -1) scaled to 0.5. It serves as a decorative scene prop.
- Add a circular platform (cylinder radius 1.5, height 0.05) at y=0 with metallic material.

PHYSICS SIMULATION:
- Implement a simple gravity-based physics system for the sunglasses. The sunglasses have properties: mass=0.05kg, velocity (vec3), gravity=-9.81 m/s².
- When not 'worn', sunglasses fall under gravity until they hit the platform (y=0.05 + half-height).
- When 'worn', sunglasses snap to position (0, 1.58, 0.33) on the mannequin head with smooth lerp (factor 0.1).
- Implement a bounce coefficient of 0.3 when hitting the platform.
- Track physics step count, incrementing each frame when physics is active.

PHYSICS DEBUG OVERLAY:
- Create a DOM overlay div (id='debug-overlay') positioned top-right, 300px wide, with semi-transparent dark background (#000000cc), monospace font, white text, padding 15px.
- Display: Gravity, Velocity (x,y,z), Position (x,y,z), Mass, Bounce coefficient, Physics steps, FPS, Collision count.
- Add a toggle button (id='toggle-debug') labeled 'Toggle Debug' that shows/hides the overlay.
- The overlay is visible by default.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Click 'Try On' button (id='btn-tryon'): Snaps sunglasses onto mannequin head, disables physics.
- Click 'Remove' button (id='btn-remove'): Detaches sunglasses from head, re-enables gravity so they fall.
- Click 'Reset Position' button (id='btn-reset'): Teleports sunglasses to (0, 2.5, 0.33) with zero velocity.
- Press 'D' key: Toggles debug overlay visibility.
- Press 'L' key: Toggles lens tint between dark (#222222, opacity 0.7), blue (#1a3a5c, opacity 0.6), and red (#5c1a1a, opacity 0.6). Cycle through in order.
- Click and drag on scene: Orbit controls around the mannequin head (use OrbitControls, target at (0, 1.3, 0)).
- Press 'P' key: Pauses/unpauses physics simulation.
- Press 'R' key: Rotates the mannequin head 45 degrees on Y axis (accumulated). If sunglasses are worn, they rotate with it.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- sunglassesPosition: {x, y, z} — current position rounded to 2 decimals
- sunglassesVelocity: {x, y, z} — current velocity rounded to 3 decimals
- isWorn: boolean — whether sunglasses are on the head
- debugVisible: boolean — whether debug overlay is visible
- physicsActive: boolean — whether physics simulation is running
- physicsSteps: number — total physics steps computed
- collisionCount: number — times sunglasses hit the platform
- lensTintIndex: number — 0=dark, 1=blue, 2=red
- lanternLoaded: boolean — true once Lantern.glb is loaded
- headRotationY: number — accumulated Y rotation of head in degrees
- fps: number — current frames per second
- bounceCoefficient: 0.3

UI BUTTONS:
- Place buttons at bottom center in a row: 'Try On' (id='btn-tryon'), 'Remove' (id='btn-remove'), 'Reset Position' (id='btn-reset'), 'Toggle Debug' (id='toggle-debug').
- Style buttons with rounded corners, padding 10px 20px, white text on dark semi-transparent background.

IMPORTANT: Initialize window.__3D_STATE__ before the first render frame. Update it every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Gravity: -9.81 m/s². Bounce coefficient: 0.3. Sunglasses must not fall below platform level (y ~= 0.08). Velocity must be zeroed when worn. Physics steps must increment monotonically. No NaN in any position or velocity field.
